QuestInfo.name: Head Full of Lies
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2450040##k planned to create a memory erasing medicine with the #t4033860#. The Shadow Knights had destroyed #p2450000#'s mind...
QuestInfo.1: The duo took the #t4033861# to #p2450000# in the hospital, hoping to save his life.
QuestInfo.2: #p2450000# was a lonely man, subjected to the lies of the Shadow Knights all his life. #p2400005# was reminded that his own future could have been the same, if he and #p2400006# had not found each other...
